## About Me

I'm an Informatics undergraduate at Telkom University (2024-2028), originally from Kutai Kartanegara, building backend systems and exploring how software actually breaks.

My focus spans backend development in Go and Java, database design, network protocol analysis, and crypto/Web3, with cyber security as the direction I'm deepening next.

## Current Focus

| Area | What I am exploring |
| --- | --- |
| **Backend Development** | Designing and building backend services and APIs with Go and Java. |
| **Databases** | Modeling, querying, and optimizing relational data for real applications. |
| **Network Protocols** | Analyzing how network protocols work and where they can be broken. |
| **Crypto & Web3** | Exploring cryptographic primitives and decentralized systems. |

## Research Direction

I care about systems that hold up under scrutiny: how services communicate, how protocols can be analyzed and attacked, and how backend architecture choices affect real-world security.
